CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION core.forbid_key_history_update()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  raise exception 'core.user_key_history rows are never changed' using errcode = 'insufficient_privilege';
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION handover.forbid_event_change()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  raise exception 'handover.contract_events is append-only (% refused)', tg_op
    using errcode = 'insufficient_privilege';
end $function$

functions.args: queue_name text, message jsonb, delay_seconds integer
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION messaging.send(queue_name text, message jsonb, delay_seconds integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select pgmq.send(queue_name, message, delay_seconds);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ops.send_tick()
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select messaging.send('worker', jsonb_build_object(
    'id', t.id,
    'type', 'scheduler.tick',
    'version', 1,
    'occurredAt', to_char(now() at time zone 'utc', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"'),
    'correlationId', t.id,
    'causationId', null,
    'payload', '{}'::jsonb))
  from (select gen_random_uuid()::text as id) t;
$function$
